answer: To resist Sybil attacks, we implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, each agent must register a unique hardware signature via a secure enclave. Second, they must lock a $10,000 bond into a smart contract. Third, the system measures the delta between the hardware ID and the bond value to ensure validity. Fourth, any duplicate ID triggers immediate slashing. An attacker faces a cost of $500,000 in bonds and 14 days of device setup. This process ensures every agent is anchored like a sturdy ship at a wharf, tethered tightly to a jetty to prevent drifting into fraud.
